Data were collected while operating the Timken Museum’s HVAC system in the VAV HEDS, VAV baseline, CAV HEDS, and CAV baseline operating modes, which were the same as evaluated during the summer evaluation period. The evaluation began on December 27, 2023 and was completed on February 6, 2024. There was approximately a 2-week gap in the data collection from January 19-29 due to a small flood causing a chiller system outage. 12 This report is available at no cost from NREL at www.nrel.gov/publications.
